summary: This RFC defines a new certificate request attribute, relatedCertRequest, and a new X.509 extension, RelatedCertificate. Together they give assurance that two certificates, for example one with a traditional key and one with a different algorithm, belong to the same entity. This supports protocols that authenticate with several certificates.

eli5.summary: If you carry two ID cards, someone should be able to tell both belong to you. This adds a way for one certificate to point to its partner.

questions: how to link two x.509 certificates
